status: Local protocol fixed before first extension run; not externally preregistered
faults: all eight combinations of sensor drift, differential label bias, historical confounding

planner.acceptance_forecast: normal approximation to fixed-sample Wilson difference rule

no_version_ablation: Each ablated policy uses its parent action selector and pilot data, but omits version bookkeeping and continues to name original process v0; the scoped parent can establish a new v1 claim. This is a deliberately faulty software ablation, not a strong competing planner.
audit: Separate hidden-state scorer checks target/evidence version match, remaining measurement faults, and target process benefit
independent_branch: Existing line-B claim is preserved by line-A actions; checked in each episode and adversarial unit tests, not a multi-claim optimization study
inference: One pilot per episode; sample size selected before pilot data; no repeated-look stopping
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap clustered by base seed/effect pair across faults and budgets; 2000 resamples; exploratory 95% percentile intervals
tuning: Development diagnostics only; report frozen evaluation even if method loses; any protocol change requires a separately versioned record
amendment_before_evaluation: Development run exposed no accepted calibration cases for the conservative decision-loss policy. Added a full-revalidation bookkeeping ablation to ensure version-change coverage. No planner utility weights, test properties, budgets, seeds, or sample sizes changed.
